welcome-title: RE A GO AMOGELA MO CHIGALEX1
welcome-sub: Kgoro ya go Nonotsha Afrika ka Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Mo ketekong ya Letsatsi la Afrika la bo-25, Porokeramo eno ya Katiso ya Pi Pioneers e simolotswe)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Mo Segopotso sa Lorato sa ga Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Thuto Hub e, e neetswe kgaitsadiake yo mogolo yo o rategang Christina Muzheki Manjengwa yo o robetseng ka 8 Phatwe 2026 mme a bolokwa ka 11 Phatwe e le Boikhutso jwa Bahale ba Zimbabwe.
Lorato lwa gago, kaelo le nonofo ya gago di tswelela go rotloetsa maikaelelo a rona a go nonotsha Afrika.
Ka bosakhutleng mo dipelong tsa rona. Robala ka Nonofo, Kgaitsadi.
intro-p1: Pi Network ke madi a dijithale le porojeke ya ecosystem ya lefatshe e diretsweng go dira gore cryptocurrency e bonale e bile e le mosola mo mongwe le mongwe.
intro-p2: Go farologana le di-cryptocurrency tsa tlwaelo tse di tlhokang metšhine e e turu ya meepo, Pi Network e letla batho ba tlwaelo go tsaya karolo ka tlhamalalo go tswa mo megaleng ya bone.
intro-list:
• Aga ikonomi ya dijithale e akaretsang mongwe le mongwe kwa ntle ga dibanka
  • Nonotsha batho ba tlwaelo mo lefatsheng ka bophara ka meepo ya mogala
  • Oketsa tiriso ya nnete ka ditiriso le DApps
  • Tshegetsa kgwebo ya motho le motho le go fokotsa dituelo
  • E dirilwe ke Stanford PhDs - Dr Nicolas Kokkalis & Dr Chengdiao Fan
  • Bo-pioneere ba fetang Dimilione di 60 mo lefatsheng ka bophara
ch1-p1: Kgato ya 1: Dounolouta Pi Network - Dirisa kgokagano: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Kgato ya 2: Ikwadise ka Facebook kgotsa Foune → Tsenya khoutu: CHIGALEX1 → Bona tuelo ya 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Meepo ya Letsatsi le Letsatsi: Boela morago dihora di le 24 mme o tobetse konopo ya legadima go tswelela ka meepo.
ch1-p4: Diphoso tse di Tlwaelegileng tse di Tshwanetseng go Thibelwa:
ch1-list2:
• O se dirise leina la maaka - le tshwanetse go tshwana le ID ya KYC
  • O se tlhame di-account tse dintsi - motho a le mongwe account e le nngwe
  • Beha alamo ya meepo dihora di le 24 go boloka sekgele
  • Tsena mo sedikeng sa tshireletso morago ga malatsi a 3 le batho ba 5 ba o ba ikanyang
ch1-list:
• Dira Pi wallet ka pabalesego
  • Wetsa 2FA
  • Wetsa KYC
  • Ipaakanyetse go fuduga ga Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Pabalesego ya wallet: O SE KE WA abalana mafoko a gago a 24 a passphrase! Setlhopha sa Pi Core GA SE NA go botsa!
ch2: KGAOLO YA 2 — THUTO YA WALLET YA PI
ch2-p1: Wallet ya gago ya Pi ke banka ya gago mo Pi Ecosystem. E tshwara madi a gago a Pi ka pabalesego mo blockchain.
ch2-p2: Mokgwa wa go dira: Bula Pi Browser → Wallet → Dira Wallet → KOPIA mafoko a gago a 24 → Boloka offline mo mafelong a 2 a a babalesegileng.
ch2-p3: Go amogela Pi: Abaalana aterese ya gago ya setšhaba (e simolola ka G...). Go romela Pi: Beha aterese ya moamogedi, tsenya palo, netefatsa.
ch2-list:
• Kwala passphrase mo pampiring, e seng setshwantsho
  • Boloka mo mafelong a 2 a a babalesegileng a a farologaneng (e seng foune fela)
  • Leka ka 1 Pi pele o romela madi a mantsi
  • Leba ditlhaka tse 4 tsa ntlha le tse 4 tsa bofelo tsa aterese ka metlha
ch2a-p1: E e mosola: Simolola ka madi a mannye a teko (1 Pi). Netefatsa ditlhaka tse 4 tsa ntlha le tse 4 tsa bofelo tsa aterese di a tshwana. O se ka wa beya passphrase ya gago mo webosaeteng epe!
ch2a-p2: Boitshwaro jo bo Tshelang: Mo katisong eno, re tla dira pontsho e tshelang ya go romela 1 Pi kwa pioneer yo mongwe go aga boikanyo. Gakologelwa: Ditirisano tsa Blockchain ga di busetswe morago!
ch3: KGAOLO YA 3 — GO TLHALOGANYA PI ECOSYSTEM
ch3-p1: Pi Browser e tshwana le Google Play Store ya Pi. DApps ke ditiriso tse di kgaoganeng tsa tiriso ya nnete — go reka, thuto, metshameko, ditirelo tsotlhe di dirisa Pi.
ch3-p2: DApps tse di Botlhokwa mo Afrika:
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Mabenkele a magolo a Pi
  • WorkforcePool - Ditiro tsa Bo-pioneere
  • CareForPi - Tshegetso ya boitekanelo
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Thuto (App eno)
  • Le ditiriso tse dingwe tse 100+
ch4: KGAOLO YA 4 — MAPOFPI & GO KOPANYA KGOEBO
ch4-p1: Bona dikgwebo tse di amogelang Pi mo lefatsheng ka bophara mo mapofpi.com. Kwadiša kgwebo ya gago ka bo wena mme o simolole go amogela Pi bakeng sa dithoto le ditirelo.
ch4-p2: Mokgwa wa go Kwadiša Kgwebo ya Gago: Ya kwa mapofpi.com → Golagana le Pi Wallet → Tsenya Kgwebo → Tsenya ditshwantsho, lefelo, ditlhagiswa → Bareki ba tla go bona! Ke ka moo Afrika e tla etelelang pele mo kamogelong ya Pi.
ch5-p1: Boleng jwa Tumalano ya Lefatshe (GCV) bo rotloetsa tiriso ya nnete. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Boleng jo bo agilwe ke bapioneere ba ba dirisang Pi mo kgwebong ya nnete.
ch5-p2: Bokao jwa GCV: GCV ga se tlhwatlhwa ya phapanyetsano. Ke motsamao wa go sireletsa boleng jwa Pi ka go dirisa Pi mo tumalanong e e kwa godimo mo thekisetsanong ya rona. Fa re dirisa Pi bakeng sa dithoto tsa nnete mo GCV, re bopa tlhoke go le tiriso. Se ke nonotsha ikonomi ya Afrika.
ch6-p1: Ithute bukana ya Doris Yin ya go tlhama tiriso le kgolo ya ecosystem. Dira patlisiso, ithute, mme o rute ba bangwe — ke ka moo re nonotshang Afrika ka teng.
ch6-p2: Karolo ya Gago jaaka Pioneer ya Afrika: Ithute → Itlwaetse → Ruta batho ba 2 → Bao ba 2 ba ruta ba bangwe ba 2. Ke ka moo re fitlhelelang 1 Milione ya Maafrika a a rutegileng! Dounolouta Whitepaper, bala, mme o abalane kitso letsatsi le letsatsi.
final-msg: Afrika e na le tshono ya go nna nngwe ya dikgaolo tse di nonofileng thata mo tirisong e e mosola mo Pi Ecosystem. Mmogo Re Aga. Mmogo Re Ruta.
